name: Login AWP
author: AWP Software

sections.description:
Login AWP turns the standard WordPress login screen into a professional, on-brand experience. No coding required — upload a logo, set a background, pick a theme, and fine-tune every detail with the visual Style Builder.

Full documentation lives on the AWP Software website:

  • Login AWP documentation: https://awp-software.com/docs-category/awp-login/
  • Documentation hub: https://awp-software.com/docs/

Brand your login in minutes

  • Upload a custom logo or use your site icon automatically
  • Set a full-screen background image with smooth transitions
  • Choose from ready-made login themes
  • Fine-tune colors, fonts, borders, spacing, and more with the live Style Builder
  • Fully responsive and retina-ready design that looks great on every device

Go further with Login AWP Pro

Login AWP is free and always will be. For advanced needs, the optional Login AWP Pro add-on adds:

  • Social Login with Facebook and Google
  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) with TOTP and email codes
  • Google reCAPTCHA protection (v2 and v3)
  • Premium login themes and exclusive Style Builder controls

Learn more at https://awp-software.com/login-awp-pro/

Built to be fast and clean

  • Lightweight and optimized for quick page loads
  • No bloat: styles load only where they’re needed
  • Seamless integration under the WordPress “Appearance” menu
  • Translation-ready (includes Spanish)

Who is it for?

Whether you manage a client site, run a brand, or build a community platform, Login AWP lets you deliver a consistent, professional first impression — effortlessly, and without touching a line of code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/login-awp/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Navigate to Appearance → Login AWP to start customizing your login screen.
sections.faq:
Can I change the background image?

Yes. Go to Appearance → Login AWP, then select the “Background” tab to upload your image.

What happens if I don’t set a logo?

Your site icon is used automatically. You can also upload a custom logo from the plugin settings.

My background image is slow to load. What should I do?

Use optimized images under 500KB in JPG or WEBP format for the best performance.

How do I apply a pre-designed theme?

Open the “Themes” tab in the plugin settings, click a theme to preview it, and activate the one you like.

Can I fully customize styles without code?

Yes. Use the “Style Builder” tab to visually change colors, fonts, borders, spacing, and more with a live preview.

How can I provide feedback about this plugin?

After using the plugin for a short period, administrators will see a feedback notification where they can leave a review. You can also share feedback when deactivating the plugin. If you prefer email, write to soporte.awp.software@gmail.com.

Where can I find the documentation?

The complete Login AWP documentation — installation, general configuration, pre-defined themes, Style Builder, troubleshooting and uninstallation — is available at https://awp-software.com/docs-category/awp-login/.

The login page isn’t loading my custom styles. What should I do?

Clear your browser cache first. If the issue persists, temporarily disable other plugins that might conflict with login page customization.

I’m getting an error when trying to send feedback while deactivating the plugin. What should I do?

Make sure you’re running the latest version — we’ve fixed the AJAX issue that could occur during feedback submission. If it continues, you can safely skip the feedback step.
sections.changelog:
3.8.2

  • SECURITY: Background and logo URLs are now escaped for the CSS url() context, so a crafted stored value can no longer inject extra declarations into the public login page.
  • FIXED: The “Remember Me” checkbox renders square again (1rem × 1rem) while its label keeps a 44px touch target (WCAG 2.1 / 2.5.5).
  • FIXED: Login AWP Pro is detected correctly when it is network-activated on a multisite network.
  • CHANGED: Deactivation feedback is now delivered to soporte.awp.software@gmail.com. Existing installs still holding the legacy address are migrated automatically.
  • CHANGED: Removed the unused feedback webhook transport and its stored setting.
  • IMPROVED: readme.txt and README now link to the official documentation on https://awp-software.com/docs/.

3.8.1

  • IMPROVED: With Login AWP Pro active, the “General” tab now shows only the enable toggle, background overlay, and extra CSS; logo, background, and size are configured in the Pro Live Preview editor.
  • FIXED: The preview now renders the logo with the same contain/aspect-ratio rules as the real login page.
  • SECURITY: Logo dimensions are clamped to a safe 1–500px range.

3.8.0

  • FIXED: Theme CSS is always generated from the selected theme with custom styles appended, so the login keeps its theme look.
  • FIXED: The login logo keeps its aspect ratio when scaled down on narrow viewports.
  • ADDED: Public helpers ThemeManager::generateThemeConfigCss() and PublicRegister::generateAppearanceCSS() for add-ons.

3.7.0

  • IMPROVED: With Login AWP Pro active, the unified “Live Preview” tab is owned by the Pro split-view editor. Free-only installs are unchanged.
  • ADDED: login_awp_live_preview_premium filter for premium add-ons.

3.6.2

  • FIXED: Hardened Theme Manager and Style Builder against corrupted login_awp_custom_styles values that could crash the login page.

3.6.1

  • FIXED: Restored the “Restore Default Theme” button and its AJAX handler.

3.6.0

  • NEW: Responsive mobile-first login layout with explicit 375 / 768 / 1024 breakpoints.
  • NEW: Scalable logo, 44px touch targets, orientation support, and prefers-reduced-motion support.
  • IMPROVED: Visible keyboard focus and long-form scrolling without clipping.

3.4.0

  • NEW: Integration hooks for the optional Login AWP Pro add-on (social login, 2FA, reCAPTCHA).
  • NEW: Premium feature detection and upgrade prompts in the admin.

3.3.0

  • COMPAT: Full compatibility with WordPress 7.1
  • IMPROVED: Verified and tested against the latest WordPress release
  • IMPROVED: Optimized plugin initialization for faster page loading
  • IMPROVED: Reduced plugin resource usage across all pages

  • IMPROVED: Enhanced plugin initialization for better reliability

  • FIXED: Corrected issue with feedback submission pointing to incorrect domain
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced error handling for feedback email and webhook submissions
